messages:
maria: Quick sync — need a decision on handshake timeslices & interleaving for streaming v1. Customer asks for function-call + partial text interleaving with deterministic resume. cc @sam @jess

sam: Are they asking client-level multiplexing or proto-level interleaving of tokens/events?

jess: FinServ customer: proto-level. They want function call args streamed incrementally, but still need an atomic finish for function calls so they can parse reliably.

kevin: Options we sketched:
1) Strict-atomic: functioncall deltas withheld until finish -> simplest, no interleaving.
2) Soft-interleave: emit partial functioncall chunks with finish_code flags (partial|final) -> allows lower latency, requires resume semantics.
3) Full event stream: structured events for call_start/call_chunk/call_end + content chunks -> most flexible, more complex for SDKs.

lina: Tradeoffs: strict = easiest for backwards compat & SDKs; soft-interleave = better UX for long args; full-event = hardest to adopt but future-proof.

maria: My leaning: default Strict-atomic for GA, soft-interleave behind opt-in header + an explicit \"finish_code\" field in each delta. Keep resume token behavior defined.

sam: Implementation note: if we do soft-interleave, we need a resume token that includes a sequence id + per-call offset. Tests for idempotence are required.

jess: Docs + SDK contract: if client doesn't understand finish_code, receiving any 'finish':true should be treated as final. Also define \"finish_code\": \"soft\" vs \"final\".

kevin: Draft proto delta snippet:
```\n{\n  \"type\":\"delta\",\n  \"stream_seq\": 12345,\n  \"finish_code\":\"soft\", // soft | final | aborted\n  \"resume_token\":\"r_ABC123\",\n  \"payload\":{\"call\":\"save_record\",\"chunk\":\"...\"}\n}\n```

tim: Launch gates:
- GA = Strict-atomic only
- Experimental soft-interleave behind X-Redwood-Stream: interleave=v1 header
- SDKs: must expose resume_token and finish_code parsing
- Perf: no more than +30ms p95 compared to GA path

maria: Agree. Who owns proto PR, SDK changes, and doc updates?

sam: I'll own JS/Python SDK changes + tests.

kevin: I'll own proto PR and runtime support backlog (canary next week). deploy-bot: canary scheduled for streaming-proto-v1 tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: canary started for streaming-proto-v1 — 02:00 UTC window.

lina: I'll update docs and compatibility matrix, include example client code.

jess: :thumbsup: finalize decision in RFC and we'll ship GA strict-atomic, opt-in soft-interleave.
